sara: Quick follow-up from the DB incident postmortem. We need firm owners, Jira links, and a one-line acceptance criteria per ticket. Reply with: Owner, brief AC, ETA, and Jira.

ashley: I'll own the TTL eviction fix + unit tests. AC: TTL edge-case fixed, unit tests + CI green. ETA: Thu. Ticket -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-7020

ben: I'll take the perf regression investigation and add a micro-benchmark to CI. AC: 99p latency <= 2% regression or an automated rollback. ETA: Fri. Ticket -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-7021

kevin: I'll write the runbook and emergency rollback script for oncall. AC: runbook step + rollback script tested on staging. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Ticket -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-7022

sara: I'll own updating the postmortem doc with RACI table and tickets. AC: doc updated with Owners table, ISO dates, and linked Jira. ETA: Mon.

oncall-bot: Reminder: RDW-7020 assigned to ashley is due in 2 days.

ashley: Adding short PR checklist to RDW-7020:
```
- [ ] fix merged
- [ ] unit tests
- [ ] CI perf snapshot attached
- [ ] postmortem linked
```

ben: Suggest adding a short mitigation owner (hotfix) in the RACI for immediate action if seen in prod again. kevin can own that.

kevin: will mark RDW-7022 high priority and include a one-click rollback command in the runbook.

sara: Please add ETA dates in YYYY-MM-DD in the postmortem Owners table. I'll verify in planning and close loop.

ashley: Updated RDW-7020 AC and pushed PR. Tagging @ben for perf verification. :thumbsup:

ben: Reviewing the PR today. Will post perf results in ticket.

kevin: RDW-7022 created and linked. ETA set to 2026-04-03.

oncall-bot: Note: RDW-7021 (ben) and RDW-7022 (kevin) flagged urgent by sara.

sara: Thanks all  I'll paste this thread into the postmortem actions and close after QA confirms ACs. If anything slips, escalate in #postmortems.
